claim: Angle snapping 9-12 degrees is correct for a pen; the cone is sized by the SLOWEST deliberate turn, and snapping is memoryless (zero lag).
field: User field-tested Feather + 90 px/mm + cm 27 + snap 12 (OW2 sens 2.25) and rated it 'by far the best feeling'. The BO6-era baseline runs snap 9 as originally trained.
method: CoherenceStabilizer/src/snap.cs: axis-aligned turn with 6-14Hz tremor overlay, worst per-report delta angle vs turn speed.
readings: On an axis turn, snapping removes 100% of perpendicular wander at zero added lag (vs Track Rails: 40% at up to 1.0mm curve lag). 12 deg covers turns down to ~15mm/s at 74%; snap 2-3 only cleans fast turns.
caution: Deliberate shallow diagonals inside the cone are flattened (measured: an intended 11-degree recoil stroke delivered at 0.4 degrees at snap 12) - hence the projectile-role warning above 6 degrees.
